title: Name normalizer
prompt: Implement `static string Normalize(string name)` — trim surrounding whitespace, then collapse every run of internal whitespace to a single space. `"  Minh   Van  "` becomes `"Minh Van"`. Null yields `""`.

tests.name: basic
tests.hint: Trim outside; internal runs — not single spaces — collapse to one.

tests.name: whitespace-kinds
tests.hint: Whitespace is more than the space character; blank input collapses to empty.
